title: Quaest Poll: Flávio Bolsonaro Edges Ahead of Lula in Runoff, 42%–41%
detail: A Quaest poll of 2,004 voters, conducted September 17–20 and released September 21, showed Senator Flávio Bolsonaro leading President Lula 42% to 41% in a simulated runoff — a technical tie inside the 2-point margin of error, but the first time in the series Bolsonaro edged ahead. In the first-round scenario, Lula still led 37% to 33%. The result capped a two-week narrowing from a prior 42–40 Lula lead, with the October 4 first round two weeks away.

title: Justice Moraes Recuses Himself From Banco Master Inquiry Into His Own Conduct
detail: STF Justice Alexandre de Moraes recused himself from the inquiry examining his own contacts with jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro, citing the procedural rule barring a judge from a case in which a spouse is a party. The recusal followed the September 1 unsealing of a Federal Police report showing Banco Master paid a R$131 million retainer to a law firm run by Moraes's wife, Viviane Barci de Moraes, and disrupted a scheduled Supreme Court vote on opening a formal investigation into Moraes over the Banco Master fraud case — a scandal already reshaping the presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.
